description: The line plot illustrates the average performance (%) of a model across three metrics—Precision, Recall, and F1-score—as a function of model size on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 70 million (70m) to 7 billion (7.0B) parameters. The y-axis, labeled "Avg. Performance (%)", spans from 0 to 80, with the data points for each metric plotted at specific model sizes: 70m, 160m, 410m, 1.0B, 1.4B, 2.8B, and 7.0B. The red line with triangle markers represents Precision, which starts at approximately 78% at 70m and shows a slight downward trend, ending at around 75% at 7.0B. The blue line with triangle markers represents Recall, which begins at about 10% at 70m and steadily increases to approximately 48% at 7.0B. The purple line with triangle markers represents F1-score, starting at around 15% at 70m and rising to about 55% at 7.0B. All three lines exhibit a general upward trend in performance as model size increases, with Precision remaining the highest-performing metric throughout the range, followed by F1-score, and then Recall.
